description: This header file defines a namespace Utils containing various utility functions for file operations, property parsing, pattern-based file searches, and string property expansion. It includes functions for reading properties from files, reading entire file content, checking if paths are files, recursive file searching with pattern matching, and expanding variables within strings based on file properties.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads a property value from a specified file based on a property name; supports recursive expansion if value begins with '$'.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Recursively searches directories for files matching patterns, considering exclusions and depth limits, storing up to 10 results.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Initiates recursive file search with specified path, depth constraints, and exclusions.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Expands variables in a string by replacing placeholders with property values read from a given file.
